source='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row))\n    top = grid[0]\n    bottom = grid[-1]\n    for c in range(w):\n        if top[c] != 0 and top[c] != 2 and bottom[c] == top[c]:\n            for r in range(1, divider):\n                out[r][c] = 4\n    return out\n'''
